About the Fellowship

The Max Weber Programme for Postdoctoral Studies at the European University Institute (EUI) in Florence, Italy, offers a , fully-funded postdoctoral fellowship for early-career researchers. The programme is highly competitive with an acceptance rate below 2%. It supports research in history, humanities, and social sciences.

Funding & Benefits

  • Monthly grant of EUR 2,500 for living expenses.
  • Additional research fund of EUR 1,500 for research-related missions.
  • Health insurance coverage for the fellow and dependents.
  • Family allowances (subject to criteria).
  • Option for part-time assistant professorship in the second year (if extended) with additional remuneration.
  • Parental leave policy.
  • Full access to EUI research facilities and library.
  • Dedicated shared workspace on campus.
  • Academic career training and mentorship.
  • Strong placement record in leading academic institutions.

Eligibility and Requirements

  • PhD completed within the last 5 years (e.g., for 2026 applications, PhD awarded after 2021).
  • Open to all nationalities.
  • Preference for candidates who do not currently hold another postdoctoral fellowship.
  • Candidates from widening countries are especially encouraged to apply.

Application Process

  1. Check eligibility and prepare required documents: CV, research proposal, letters of recommendation, proof of PhD.
  2. Identify and contact a potential EUI faculty mentor whose research aligns with yours.
  3. Submit the online application by 16 October 2026 via the official EUI portal.
  4. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interview (late 2026/early 2027).
  5. Final decisions announced in Spring 2027. Fellowship starts September 2027.

Selection Process

  • Screening based on eligibility.
  • Shortlisting by an international panel of experts.
  • Interview for shortlisted candidates.
  • Selection based on academic merit and research excellence.

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Application Deadline16 October 2026
InterviewsLate 2026 – Early 2027
Final DecisionSpring 2027
Fellowship StartSeptember 2027

Official Link

  • Main Fellowship Page: https://www.eui.eu/ProgrammesAndFellowships/MaxWeberProgramme
  • Application Page: https://www.eui.eu/ProgrammesAndFellowships/MaxWeberProgramme/ApplyForAMaxWeberFellowship

Important Notes

  • No application fee.
  • Research proposal is the most critical part of the application.
  • Contacting a faculty mentor is highly recommended.
  • EUI website may occasionally experience technical issues; retry or check social media for updates.

Application guides

  • How to Ask for a Recommendation Letter: Emails and Preparation
  • A 12-Month Study Abroad Application Plan for Master's and PhD Applicants

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 16 October 2026, 14:00 CEST. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
